results.text: Protective effects of quercetin against glyphosate-induced nephrotoxicity in rats: role of oxidative stress, inflammatory response, and apoptotic pathways. Glyphosate, the most widely used herbicide globally, accumulates in renal tissue causing kidney damage through incompletely understood mechanisms. This study evaluated quercetin's nephroprotective effect against glyphosate-induced kidney injury in rats.
